subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding the relationship between volume and liquid capacity (1 cubic cm = 1 ml)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student fills a virtual cube-shaped container with liquid and compares the ml reading to the cube count
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a pictured container's volume in cubic cm to its capacity in ml
exercise.abstract: Student converts between cubic centimeters and milliliters

misconception_flags: treats volume and capacity as unrelated rather than equivalent measures

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
